about: Animated Instagram carousel (Phase 3), taken from the sample carousels in assets/reference/creative/carousels/ (carousel_09-11 and 01). Boxes are shares (0-1) of the canvas; zone boxes are shares of textPanel. Zones reuse the Phase 2 text overlay: the body line is the subheadline zone, list items the points zone. Sizes are px at the canvas width. Slide text marks highlight words as **word**.

palette.sampled: 2026-10-12 from the style frames of carousel_09-11: background = mean of the dark area (navy = its lifted centre), glow = saturated wave dots, crest = the brightest wave dots, highlight = the blue headline words, text = the white headline

cover.use: Slide 1, the hook: the problem or the promise of the topic.
cover.illustration: the topic's hero visual: a glossy white 3D robot or one large glowing neon icon that sums up the topic

point.use: A middle slide with one point: a short headline and the concrete fact or action.
point.illustration: one visual for this point: a white 3D robot acting it out, or a small group of neon line icons on glass tiles

stat.use: A middle slide with one big number from a cited research article, what it means and what to do.
stat.illustration: a holographic chart, gauge or rising bar graph that shows the trend, without any digits

list.use: A middle slide with 3-4 short steps or items.
list.illustration: a vertical flow of 3-4 neon line icons in rounded glass tiles joined by glowing arrows, one icon per item

final.use: Slide 8: one question that invites comments, a short invitation line, the Like/Share/Save row and the logo.
final.illustration: a friendly white 3D robot with a glowing question mark, or neon icons that fit the question
final.stillNote: Keep the bottom fifth of the frame calm and dark: an icon row is added there.

stills.estimateNote: unverified: PHASE3-DECISION section 6 (about 1-5 credits per image); set model, referenceImages and estimatedCredits from the plugin listing (section 10)
stills.negativePrompt: text, letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, logos, watermarks, people, faces, human hands, human figures

check.calibrated: 2026-10-12: the app background scores edges 0.000, std 2.2, p95 0.06 in the text panel; every sample half with text or illustration scores edges >= 0.022 and std >= 31

stills.prompt: Square 1:1 illustration for one slide of an animated Instagram carousel about "{topic}". Subject: {illustration}. Place the subject in the right half of the frame ({area}); keep the left half calm, dark and empty, because text is added there later. Background: deep dark navy ({background} to {navy}) with a glowing blue particle-dot wave along the bottom ({glow}, light-blue crests {crest}), faint bokeh and a few thin glowing arcs. Style: glossy white 3D robots, neon line icons and holographic UI cards and charts in electric blue, soft glow, high contrast, a clean premium tech look like the style references. No people, no faces, no human hands, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no labels on screens or icons.

samples.headline: {topic}: **what changes now**
samples.body: Eight short slides: what changes, what it costs, and the first step for your team.

samples.headline: Your team still answers **leads by hand**
samples.body: Each enquiry waits until someone is free, so hot leads go **cold** before anyone replies.

samples.headline: of buyers pick the **first reply**
samples.body: Speed wins the deal, so the first answer should arrive within minutes, not hours.

samples.headline: An AI assistant replies in **seconds**
samples.body: It answers common questions, qualifies the lead and **books a call** while your team sleeps.

samples.headline: Your CRM **updates itself**
samples.body: Every chat, booking and follow-up lands in one place, so nobody copies data by hand.

samples.headline: People do the work that **matters**
samples.body: Your team spends its time on calls, offers and clients instead of repeating the same answers.
